chunks: Ali narrated from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Uthman, who said:
When Isma'il, the son of Abi Abdillah عليه السلام, died, Abu Abdillah عليه السلام came out and went ahead of the bier without sandals and without a cloak.

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the central figure in the report
key_terms.إِسْمَاعِيلُ: Isma'il, the son mentioned in the report
key_terms.السَّرِيرَ: the bier or funeral cot carried for the deceased
key_terms.مَاتَ: died; indicates the occurrence of death

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام behave at the funeral of his son Isma'il?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the conduct of Abu Abdillah عليه السلام at the death of his son Isma'il. It depicts a visible expression of grief and funerary comportment, preserving a historical example from the Imam’s practice.
